newsitem.title: INDIA: India Global Tel in 60 mln SFr bond issue.
newsitem.headline: India Global Tel in 60 mln SFr bond issue.

text.p: Indian telecommunication firm Global Tele-Systems Ltd said on Thursday it had concluded a 60 million Swiss Franc Foreign Currency Convertible Bond (FCCB) issue in the international market.
"The issue received a good response from international investors and was fully subscribed," Global Tele Systems said.
Lead managed by Swiss bank Credit Suisse, the FCCB has a tenure of seven years from the date of issue, with a put/call option at the end of five years, the firm said in a statement.
"The company thus has the distinction of being the first telecommunications company in India to raise money through the FCCBs' issue which has a floating rate coupon system," the statement said.

The proceeds of the FCCB issue will be used to repay loans, fund Global Tele Systems' projects, strengthen its network and software divisions, and improve its distribution network, the statement said.
